characters.name: Lucia Caminos
characters.summary: Just released from Leonida Penitentiary and determined that every move from here on is a smart one.
body: Lucia learned to fight from her father and has been fighting for her family ever since. That loyalty is what put her inside Leonida Penitentiary, and luck is what got her out.
She wants the good life her mother has dreamed about since their days in Liberty City, and she is done leaving it to chance. Teaming up with Jason looks like her way out.

characters.name: Jason Duval
characters.summary: A former soldier raised among grifters who has slipped back into running drugs in the Leonida Keys.
body: Jason grew up around small-time crooks. A spell in the Army was meant to straighten out a rough adolescence; instead he ended up in the Keys doing what he knows best, working for local drug runners.
He wants an easy life, but things keep getting harder. Meeting Lucia might be the best thing that ever happened to him, or the worst.
ties: Lives rent-free on Brian Heder's property

characters.name: Cal Hampton
characters.summary: Jason's friend, most at ease at home with a few beers and the Coast Guard radio chatter turned up.
body: Cal is Jason's friend and another of Brian Heder's associates. He is happily paranoid, spending his time at home listening in on Coast Guard traffic.
Jason has bigger plans. Cal would rather stay exactly where he is.

characters.name: Boobie Ike
characters.summary: A Vice City legend who turned street reputation into real estate, a strip club and a recording studio.
body: Boobie is one of the few who made the jump from the street to an empire of property, nightlife and a studio. He is all smiles until it is time to talk business.
What he cares about most is Only Raw Records, the label he runs with Dre'Quan Priest. All it needs now is a hit.
Rockstar heads his profile with the line "It's all about heart — the Jack of Hearts." The page does not say what the Jack of Hearts is.
ties: Runs Only Raw Records with Dre'Quan Priest
Backs the label Real Dimez are signed to

characters.name: Dre'Quan Priest
characters.summary: More hustler than gangster. Dealing paid the bills, but music was always the real plan.
body: Dre'Quan sold on the street to get by, with his eye on the music industry the whole time. He books the acts at Boobie Ike's club and runs Only Raw Records alongside him.
Signing Real Dimez could be the break that moves him beyond club bookings.
ties: Runs Only Raw Records with Boobie Ike

characters.name: Real Dimez
characters.summary: Two friends since high school who went from shaking down dealers to rap tracks and a nonstop social feed.
body: Bae-Luxe and Roxy have been friends since school. They turned their time squeezing local dealers into rap tracks and a relentless social media presence.
An early hit with local rapper DWNPLY took them up; five years and a lot of trouble later they are signed to Only Raw Records and hoping for a second one.
ties: Signed to Only Raw Records by Dre'Quan Priest

characters.name: Raul Bautista
characters.summary: A veteran bank robber with charm and patience, always looking for talent willing to take the big risks.
body: Raul has the confidence, charm and cunning of someone who has been robbing banks for a long time, and he is always recruiting.
His recklessness raises the stakes with every score. Sooner or later his crew will have to double down or walk away.

characters.name: Brian Heder
characters.summary: An old-school drug runner from the golden age of Keys smuggling, still moving product through his boat yard.
body: Brian has been around long enough to let other people do his dirty work. He still runs product through the boat yard he keeps with his third wife, Lori.
He lets Jason stay rent-free at one of his properties, on the understanding that Jason helps out with local shakedowns.
ties: Landlord and employer of Jason Duval

locations.name: Vice City
locations.summary: The crowded heart of Leonida, and the series' first return to its Miami stand-in since 2002.
body: Rockstar's own description covers the pastel art deco hotels and white sands of Ocean Beach, the bakeries of Little Cuba, the bootleg brands of the Tisha-Wocka flea market and VC Port, billed as the cruise ship capital of the world.
Other districts named in official material are La Perle, Stockyard, Tequesta and Vice Beach. Rockstar has not published a full district list.

The GTA Wiki's fan-compiled list adds Belville, Crosstown, Downtown, Ekanfinaka, Peacock Bay, Rockridge and Southside. It treats Vice Beach, with Ocean Beach and Washington Beach, as a neighbouring city across the bay, and records two venues, Fleeca Field and Sahara Arena. These are community readings of the trailers and screenshots, not a list from Rockstar.

locations.name: Leonida Keys
locations.summary: The island chain south of Vice City: easy living on some of the most beautiful and dangerous water around. Jason's story starts here.
body: Life in the Keys is not flashy, but it is easy. Official images show divers over coral, party boats, jet skis and a crowded beach bar.
It is also smuggling country. Brian Heder runs his operation from a boat yard here, and Jason works for the local drug runners.

Fans have picked out four island names so far: Key Lento, East Key, Catalan Key and Goose Key. A Leonida Keys road sign appears in the Launch Trailer. The island names are community readings recorded by the GTA Wiki, not a list from Rockstar.

locations.name: Grassrivers
locations.summary: Leonida's vast wetlands, where you never quite know what is under the surface.
body: Grassrivers is swamp, mangroves and open shallow water between the city and the interior. The alligators are the famous attraction, though Rockstar hints at deadlier predators and stranger finds.
Official images show airboats, alligators and a police helicopter chasing a pickup through the swamp.

The GTA Wiki lists Watson Bay as the one town in the wetlands, and suggests the name nods to The Everglades: River of Grass, the 1947 book by Marjory Stoneman Douglas. Both are community notes, not statements from Rockstar.

locations.name: Port Gellhorn
locations.basedOn: Florida's faded Gulf Coast resort towns
locations.summary: A former holiday hotspot that lost its tourists and found a rougher economy to replace them.
body: Port Gellhorn used to be the centre of Leonida's tourist trade. What is left is cheap motels, shut-down attractions and empty strip malls.
The new economy runs on rougher goods, and the local transport of choice is a dirt bike.

locations.name: Ambrosia
locations.summary: Inland Leonida, where the Allied Crystal sugar refinery supplies the jobs and a biker gang supplies the rest.
body: Ambrosia is built around the state's sugar industry, a long way from the coast. The Allied Crystal refinery provides the work.
By Rockstar's account, the local biker gang provides almost everything else.

locations.name: Mount Kalaga National Park
locations.basedOn: Florida's state forests and hill country
locations.summary: Forest, high ground and backwoods against the northern border: the closest Leonida gets to wilderness.
body: Mount Kalaga is a national landmark at the top of the map, pitched for its hunting, fishing and off-road trails.
The backwoods around it are home to people who want to live well away from the government. Official images show dirt bikes, an ATV, hunters, a cougar stalking deer and a kayaker.

vehicles.name: Classic Cars
vehicles.summary: Old American metal, restored and rebuilt. Rockstar's Ultimate Edition screenshots show the Vapid Ganado Retro Build, a low-riding pickup.
body: The Vapid Ganado Retro Build is named and pictured in Rockstar's Ultimate Edition screenshots. Its in-game class and performance have not been published.

vehicles.name: Sports Cars
vehicles.summary: Low, wide and fast. Rockstar's Ultimate Edition screenshots show the '95 Grotti Cheetah.
body: The '95 Grotti Cheetah is named and pictured in Rockstar's Ultimate Edition screenshots. Its in-game class and performance have not been published.

vehicles.name: Boats
vehicles.summary: From Brian Heder's boat yard to the party boats of the Keys, Leonida lives on the water.
body: Official images of the Leonida Keys show a raft of party boats. Brian Heder moves product through a boat yard there.

vehicles.name: Airboats
vehicles.summary: Flat-bottomed and fan-driven, the way across Grassrivers.
body: Airboats appear in Rockstar's Grassrivers images, and airboating was among the activities in the Extended Look.

vehicles.name: Pickups, Dirt Bikes and ATVs
vehicles.summary: Mud-ready machines for the backwoods, from Port Gellhorn to Mount Kalaga.
body: Official images show dirt bikes and an ATV in the mud at Mount Kalaga and a pickup being chased through Grassrivers. Rockstar's Port Gellhorn text tells you to jump on a dirt bike.

vehicles.name: '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy
vehicles.summary: An off-road buggy included with the Ultimate Edition, pitched for the backwoods of Mount Kalaga.
body: Rockstar's Ultimate Edition description presents it as a Mud Club vehicle with strong off-road handling.
It can be kept at the Paradise Garage in Watson Bay, which Rockstar says has a weapon locker and somewhere to drop off stolen goods for fencing.

vehicles.name: Planes and Helicopters
vehicles.summary: Seaplanes over the Keys and helicopters over everything.
body: Official images show a seaplane over the Leonida Keys, a police helicopter over Grassrivers and a news helicopter over Mount Kalaga.

vehicles.name: Jet Skis and Kayaks
vehicles.summary: Small craft for the Keys and the rivers of the north.
body: Jet skis and kayaking were both shown in the Extended Look. Official images show jet skis in the Keys and a kayaker at Mount Kalaga.

gameplay.name: Switching between Jason and Lucia
gameplay.summary: Control passes between the two leads through most of the game: instantly when they are together, after a few seconds when apart.
body: The lead you are not playing acts on their own and can be called by phone. Some story sequences lock the swap. This is what the Extended Look footage showed; Rockstar has not described it in writing.

gameplay.name: Six-star wanted level
gameplay.summary: Six stars are back. Police react to what is witnessed or caught on camera, and track your description, clothes and vehicle separately.
body: Changing clothes or vehicle, or covering your face beforehand, changes how long the heat lasts. Shown in the Extended Look, not published as a feature list.

gameplay.name: Combat
gameplay.summary: Enemies can be wounded or disarmed rather than killed, and heavy hits pull the camera into slow motion.
body: Shown in the Extended Look. Rockstar has not published written detail.

gameplay.name: Stealing cars
gameplay.summary: From breaking a window to working the lock with a slim jim; better cars carry electronic locks, alarms and trackers.
body: A phone app scans a car first and reports what it is worth and how it is protected. Shown in the Extended Look.

gameplay.name: Robberies
gameplay.summary: Robberies trade speed against take: forcing a safe is quicker but damages what is inside.
body: There are second exits for when the front door stops being an option. Shown in the Extended Look.

activities.name: Racing
activities.summary: Races on tarmac and on dirt both appeared in the Extended Look.

activities.name: Water sports
activities.summary: Jet skis, kayaking and diving were all shown, with the Keys as the natural home for them.

activities.name: Sports and leisure
activities.summary: The gym, basketball, pool, mini golf and parachuting all appeared in the Extended Look, along with nightclubs.

activities.name: Hunting, fishing and off-roading
activities.summary: Rockstar pitches Mount Kalaga National Park for its hunting, fishing and off-road trails.

activities.name: Everyday life
activities.summary: Petting a dog, watching television, shopping, and a phone the character actually holds.

wildlife.name: Alligators
wildlife.summary: The most famous attraction in Grassrivers, by Rockstar's own description.

wildlife.name: Cougars
wildlife.summary: An official Mount Kalaga image shows a cougar stalking deer at a stream. A wildcat also appears in a Grassrivers image.

wildlife.name: Deer
wildlife.summary: Seen at a stream in Mount Kalaga National Park in an official image.

wildlife.name: Sea turtles
wildlife.summary: An official Leonida Keys image shows divers among coral with a sea turtle.

wildlife.name: Dogs
wildlife.summary: Dogs can be petted, as shown in the Extended Look.

businesses.name: Only Raw Records
businesses.summary: The Vice City record label run by Boobie Ike and Dre'Quan Priest. Real Dimez are signed to it.

businesses.name: Allied Crystal sugar refinery
businesses.summary: Ambrosia's sugar refinery and the source of the town's jobs.

businesses.name: Tisha-Wocka flea market
businesses.summary: A flea market known, in Rockstar's words, for its bootleg brands.

businesses.name: Brian Heder's boat yard
businesses.summary: The Keys boat yard Brian runs with his wife Lori, and the front for his smuggling.

businesses.name: Fleeca bank
businesses.summary: A Fleeca bank is named in the captions of Rockstar's launch screenshot gallery.

businesses.name: The Rusty Anchor
businesses.summary: A bar named in the captions of Rockstar's launch screenshot gallery.

businesses.name: Delights Cabaret
businesses.summary: A cabaret named in the captions of Rockstar's launch screenshot gallery.

factions.name: Raul Bautista's crew
factions.summary: The bank robbery crew Raul leads. Rockstar has not named anyone else in it.

factions.name: Ambrosia biker gang
factions.summary: An unnamed biker gang that, by Rockstar's account, runs almost everything in Ambrosia the refinery does not.

factions.name: Keys drug runners
factions.summary: The smuggling trade of the Leonida Keys, where Jason works and Brian Heder is the old guard.

music.name: Original score by Justice
music.summary: The electronic duo Justice composed the game's score. A 30-track album is due on December 11, 2026.
body: Singles so far are "Flower in a Hurricane" and "Pusher". The Launch Trailer is set to new music from the duo.
Justice are the French duo Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay. Rockstar calls the score adaptive: it changes with how you play.
"Flower in a Hurricane" features Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard. "Pusher" features Gesaffelstein.
The album comes to streaming services, CD and vinyl. Rockstar's shop lists a limited triple crystal clear vinyl and a double CD.

music.name: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album
music.summary: The official soundtrack album: 34 original tracks made with Atlantic Records, out with the game on November 19, 2026.
body: Rockstar's music page lists ten singles: "That's It" by Yung Lean (featuring Future and Metro Boomin); "RHYNO" by Travis Scott; "Sexy Magic" by CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. and Etienne de Crécy; "Flower in a Hurricane" by Justice; "Last Thing You Need" by Morgan Wallen; "Suzuki" by Fuerza Regida; "Macacoa 2000" by Rauw Alejandro; "Don't Chart" by Cardi B; "Blood In Your Eyes" by Tove Lo; and "Bright Lights, Big City" by Keith Richards.
Rockstar's shop lists the album on an exclusive vinyl and a standard vinyl.

music.name: Radio stations and podcasts
music.summary: Rockstar has named six radio stations and confirmed on-demand podcasts, plus radio on foot through headphones.
body: The six are Cocoteo FM, Back Country Radio, AfroBank FM, The Chamber, Flash FM and Dirty South Classics. Each has its own entry in this category, with its genre and hosts.
Rockstar's music page also mentions stations for classic rock and talk radio, without naming them, and says the game has the series' widest selection of radio and podcasts.

music.name: Trailer 1 song
music.summary: The reveal trailer was set to Tom Petty's "Love Is a Long Road".

editions.name: Standard Edition
editions.summary: The base game on PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S.
body: Pre-orders include the Vintage Vice City Pack: the '55 Vapid Stanier with a garage by Ocean Beach, outfits and hairstyles for Jason and Lucia, and a weapon pattern.
A digital pre-order on either console includes one month of GTA+. PlayStation's page adds that it can be claimed until March 31 and renews as a paid subscription unless cancelled.
The boxed version holds a download code and no disc. The Vintage Vice City Pack comes with pre-orders and with purchases made before November 20, 2026.

editions.name: Ultimate Edition
editions.summary: The game plus an exclusive collection of items tied to Jason and Lucia's story.
body: Rockstar lists vehicles (among them the '95 Grotti Cheetah, '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy and Shitzu Squalo), the Hawk & Little Morgan Revolvers, personalized pistols, four shops that open only with this edition, a gang raid and a car-collecting commission. Each has its own entry.

PlayStation's page groups the extras as vehicles and garages, weapons, looks, and a special commission and customs. Two of Rockstar's Ultimate Edition screenshot sets are titled "Vice City Style" and "Goodtime Gear".

The PlayStation Store also lists an Ultimate Edition Upgrade as a separate add-on. A digital pre-order on either console includes one month of GTA+. PlayStation's page adds that it can be claimed until March 31 and renews as a paid subscription unless cancelled.
There is no boxed Ultimate Edition. Standard Edition owners, boxed or digital, can buy the Ultimate Edition Upgrade from the PlayStation or Microsoft store once their copy is redeemed.

news.name: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival
news.summary: A live launch event at Mana Wynwood in Miami, with two stages of artists from the game and its soundtrack.
body: Announced by Rockstar on November 9, presented with PlayStation and produced by the creators of III Points. The announced performers include Travis Scott, Don Toliver, Kodak Black and Sofaygo (as Cactus Jack), Cardi B, Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso, Justice (DJ set), Metro Boomin and Tainy.
Tickets went through a pre-sale lottery that closed on November 10, limited to two per code.

news.name: Launch day
news.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI releases on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar's support site gives the time as midnight local time in every region.

news.name: A first update arrives before launch
news.summary: Outlets report a mandatory update, version 1.002.000, of about 1 GB on PlayStation 5, rolling out six days before launch.
body: Rockstar has published no patch notes, so what the update changes is not known.
This comes from press reports of what consoles are downloading, not from a Rockstar announcement.

news.name: 30 frames per second, and what PS5 Pro adds
news.summary: Rockstar says the game targets 30 frames per second on both consoles. PlayStation 5 Pro adds PSSR upscaling and ray-traced shadows.
body: The same post says the game will be playable through Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One consoles, using Xbox Series S graphics settings, and supports Remote Play on PlayStation and Xbox.
It arrived with a new video set to "Blood in Your Eyes" by Tove Lo, from Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album.

news.name: Pre-load opens
news.summary: Pre-loading begins on both consoles. PlayStation 5 pre-loads opened at midnight local time, and Xbox pre-loads opened worldwide at 12 a.m. GMT. Rockstar says the download needs up to 212 GB, depending on the console.

news.name: Take-Two: development is complete
news.summary: On Take-Two's earnings call, chief executive Strauss Zelnick said Rockstar has completed development and that pre-orders are far above the company's first expectations.
body: The company gave no pre-order number. Figures quoted elsewhere are outside estimates.

news.name: Launch gallery: 39 new screenshots
news.summary: Rockstar's launch gallery adds 39 screenshots, with captions naming a Fleeca bank, The Rusty Anchor bar and Delights Cabaret.

news.name: A free poster and map of Leonida on launch day
news.summary: Rockstar will add a printable cover art poster and map of Leonida to its site as a free download on November 19.
body: A double-sided printed version follows from the Rockstar Store shortly after launch: $0.99 on its own, or free with any purchase.
The same post dated the pre-load and said code-in-box copies should reach retailers from November 12.

news.name: Original score by Justice
news.summary: Rockstar announces the 30-track score album by Justice, out December 11.

news.name: Launch Trailer
news.summary: Rockstar's final trailer before release, set to new music from Justice.
body: Rockstar's post with the trailer sums up the story: Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them, and when an easy score goes wrong they are caught in a criminal conspiracy that stretches across Leonida.

news.name: Six radio stations named
news.summary: Rockstar names six radio stations and confirms on-demand podcasts and radio on foot.
body: Radio and podcasts play in vehicles and on foot, through headphones and earbuds connected to Jason and Lucia's smartphones. Rockstar calls podcasts a first for the series.

news.name: Clothing and collectibles at the Rockstar Store
news.summary: Rockstar opens the Grand Theft Auto VI Collection at its store: tees, caps and collectibles.
body: The range includes logo tees, Goodtime State tees with characters from Macca the Gator, which Rockstar calls Leonida's hit TV show, fitted caps, a keychain, a Vice City money clip, a Zippo lighter, tote bags and stickers.
Rockstar says the Goodtime State styles are the ones Jason and Lucia wear in the Ultimate Edition.

news.name: Collector's box announced
news.summary: The Goodtime State - Vice City Collection: a $399.99 box of eleven collectibles that does not include the game.
body: Rockstar lists a 6-inch Macca the Gator figure with a stash compartment, Oakley Frogskins sunglasses, a New Era snapback hat, a Macca the Gator magnetic mirror, a swizzle spoon, a razor blade keychain, a Leonida Keys crossbody bag, a Chunkee the Manatee shot glass, an enamel pin set, stickers and a double-sided poster of the Leonida landscape.

The set takes its theme from Macca the Gator, which Rockstar describes as Leonida's hit TV show. It arrives on November 19 and is sold while supplies last. The price comes from GTA 6 Wiki, not from Rockstar's post.

news.name: The Album announced
news.summary: A 34-track official soundtrack album made with Atlantic Records, arriving with the game.

news.name: An Extended Look
news.summary: Twenty-six minutes of gameplay captured on PlayStation 5: the first sustained look at the game in motion.

news.name: Pre-orders open
news.summary: Two editions at $79.99 and $99.99, with the Vintage Vice City Pack for everyone who pre-orders.

news.name: Release moves to November 19, 2026
news.summary: Rockstar moves the game from May 26 to November 19, 2026, its second delay.

news.name: Trailer 2
news.summary: More of Jason and Lucia, and the first time six supporting characters are named.

news.name: Release set for May 26, 2026
news.summary: The original 2025 window gives way to a specific date for the first time.

news.name: Trailer 1
news.summary: The reveal: Vice City, the State of Leonida and a female lead, set to Tom Petty's "Love Is a Long Road".

faq.name: When does GTA 6 come out?
faq.summary: November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, at midnight local time in every region.

faq.name: Is GTA 6 coming to PC?
faq.summary: A PC version has not been announced. The game is announced for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

faq.name: Where is GTA 6 set?
faq.summary: In the State of Leonida, with Vice City as its biggest city. Vice City is the series' stand-in for Miami.

faq.name: Who are the main characters?
faq.summary: Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, the two playable leads.

faq.name: Has GTA 6 been delayed?
faq.summary: Twice. A 2025 window became May 26, 2026, which then became November 19, 2026.

faq.name: How much does GTA 6 cost?
faq.summary: $79.99 for the Standard Edition and $99.99 for the Ultimate Edition.

faq.name: Can I play it on PS4 or Xbox One?
faq.summary: Not natively: the game is made for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar says it will be playable on Xbox One consoles by streaming through Xbox Cloud Gaming.
body: The cloud version uses Xbox Series S graphics settings, and Rockstar notes that connection speed can affect how it plays. PlayStation's page says the game is not playable on PlayStation 4.

faq.name: What frame rate does GTA 6 run at?
faq.summary: Rockstar says it targets 30 frames per second on both consoles.
body: On PlayStation 5 Pro it adds PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) and ray-traced shadows. Rockstar has not given a resolution.

faq.name: What about GTA Online?
faq.summary: No date or detail yet. Rockstar has said the online component follows the single-player game rather than shipping with it.

faq.name: What is GTA 6 rated?
faq.summary: ESRB Mature 17+, for Blood and Gore, Intense Violence, Mature Humor, Nudity, Strong Language, Strong Sexual Content, and Use of Drugs and Alcohol. The rating also notes In-Game Purchases.

faq.name: What does the PlayStation 5 version support?
faq.summary: PlayStation lists it as PS5 Pro Enhanced, with Tempest 3D Audio, fast loading from the SSD, and the DualSense controller's haptic feedback, adaptive triggers and speaker. Remote Play is supported.
body: Rockstar adds that PlayStation 5 Pro gets PSSR upscaling and ray-traced shadows, and that the game targets 30 frames per second. Neither page gives a resolution. PlayStation's page also says the game is not playable on PlayStation 4.

faq.name: Can GTA 6 be played offline?
faq.summary: PlayStation's store page lists it as a one-player game with offline play enabled.

faq.name: Is there a disc version?
faq.summary: No. The boxed Standard Edition holds a download code and no disc, and there is no boxed Ultimate Edition.
body: PlayStation codes work only on accounts in the region group they were sold for, so Rockstar recommends buying in the country of your platform account. Xbox codes are not region-locked.
In Japan, codes expire 170 days after launch day.
